CloudCoin.name: Extended sprite: wiggler flower / coin cloud coin
summary: Handles extended sprite $0E (flower dropped by Wiggler) and the smiley coin from the coin game cloud.
Applies gravity; the flower sways left and right, the coin bounces once on the floor and can be collected by the cape.
Draws as 8x8 (flower) or 16x16 (coin) and deletes the sprite when offscreen.

s029D5E.name: Data: unused extended sprite animation frames
summary: Frame sequence for UnusedExtendedSpr, indexed by timer / 4.

UnusedExtendedSpr.name: Unused. Multi-tile extended sprite following a sprite
summary: Unused extended sprite that follows the sprite whose index is in its X speed, draws up to 3 animated tiles and hurts Mario on contact (probably).
Deleted when the followed sprite is no longer in status 8 or its timer runs out.

s029E36.name: Data: launcher arm Y speeds
summary: $08, $00, $F8 indexed by arm phase.

LauncherArm.name: Extended sprite: launcher arm
summary: Hand/arm graphic that moves down, pauses and moves up by phase from its timer [$176F] (>= $60, >= $30, less).
Drawn as a 16x16 tile; tile $84 in the first phase, $A4 later.

LavaSplash.name: Extended sprite: lava splash
summary: Small splash particle that moves by its speed, falls under gravity and is deleted when its Y speed reaches $30 or it goes offscreen.
Animated by timer [$176F] / 8 using LavaSplashTiles2.

WaterBubble.name: Extended sprite: water bubble
summary: Bubble rises, wobbles horizontally and pops when it touches a block (or, probably, leaves the water in a partial-water level).
Drawn with tile $1C.

YoshiFireball.name: Extended sprite: Yoshi fireball
summary: Moves by its speed, burns sprites it touches (ProcessFireball) and animates between tiles $04 and $2B, flipped to face its direction.

s029FA2.name: Data: fireball Y adjustments and OAM indices
summary: DATA_029FA2: Y push-out table; DATA_029FA3/029FA5: OAM indices for Mario fireball slots 8-9 (read at offset 8 and 9).

MarioFireball.name: Extended sprite: Mario fireball
summary: Gravity +4 (max $30), moves, bounces off the floor and dissipates after hitting a wall twice or leaving the screen.
Calls ProcessFireball to hit sprites. In Mode 7 boss rooms ([$0D9B] bit 6) it is drawn with normal OAM instead of extended OAM.

ProcessFireball.name: Fireball hits sprites: entry
summary: Runs only every 4th frame per slot. Saves the extended sprite index to [$185E] and starts the loop over sprites 9..0.

FireRtLoopStart.name: Fireball vs. sprite loop
summary: For each normal sprite: skips dead, fire-immune, eaten or other-layer sprites, tests contact with the fireball, then kills it, turns it into a coin or counts hits (Chuck).
Parameters: [$185E] = extended sprite index.

ChuckFireKill.name: Kill sprite by fireball
summary: Plays sound 2, sets the sprite to status 2 (killed) with death speeds away from Mario and awards 80 points.

TurnSpriteToCoin.name: Turn sprite into moving coin
summary: Plays the coin sound, changes the sprite to $21 (moving coin) status 8, re-inits its tables and launches it upward.

FireRtNextSprite.name: Fireball loop: next sprite
summary: Decrements the loop index and restores [$15E9] when finished.

FireKillSpeedX.name: Table: fireball kill X speeds and OAM indices
summary: $F0/$10: death X speed. DATA_02A153: OAM index per extended sprite slot.

ReznorFireTiles.name: Table: Reznor fireball tiles and properties

ReznorFireball.name: Extended sprite: Reznor fireball
summary: Moves by its speed; in normal levels it uses the generic 8x8 fireball drawing, in Mode 7 boss rooms ([$0D9B] bit 7) a 16x16 animated fireball.
Also contains the generic extended sprite drawing routine at $02A1A4, which is shared by many extended sprites, and the delete routine at $02A211.

FlameRemnant.name: Extended sprite: small flame remnant
summary: Animated 8x8 flame that flickers out during the last $50 frames of its timer [$176F] and can be destroyed by the cape.
